method.method_draft: First describe the image: terminal a connects to the negative side of source E, the positive side of E connects to resistor R, and current I flows through R toward terminal b. Choose V_a = 0 as reference. From a to the node after the source, the potential becomes E. Across the resistor in the current direction, the potential decreases by IR = 8 V, so V_b = E - 8. From the text, U_ab = -10 V means V_b - V_a = -10 V in this convention, hence E - 8 = -10 and E = -2 V. Output -2.0.
